In process variant A), it is appropriate to initially charge a compound of the formula I with N-bromosuccinimide (NBS) and radical initiator in solvent, and then to heat gradually. The reaction may optionally be accelerated by adding a little bromine. Preference is given to using NBS in excess. In process variant B), it is appropriate to initially charge a compound of the formula I in solvent and then, after heating under irradiation with a photolamp, to add bromine dropwise.
